articles.title: Why the Astro site uses a Strapi content snapshot
articles.summary: A JSON snapshot keeps builds automated without an online CMS.
articles.content:
Strapi stays local. The site builds from JSON so CI does not depend on a laptop.

One data contract

Astro reads the same shape in development and production.

Repeatable builds

The snapshot is reviewed with the source code.
